name: isaac_home_dev
_note: Development only (9 Nov 2026): validates composed Isaac homes, measures per-class Qwen3-VL recognisability and records a perception-capture dataset. Not an evaluation. Homes use the generator's development seeds 100-103 (the held-out seeds of the MuJoCo evaluation are 6000+ and are not touched). Targets come from the Isaac target set (refrigerator, bed, toilet, stove, washing_machine, workbench, sofa; no bathtub). Excluded classes (experiments/configs/isaac_assets.json 'excluded', version 1) are omitted and logged per home. Rule 3 class: environment simplification. Kitchens: l_shape is the development kitchen; the others are held-out candidates, used here for load check and recognisability only (no exploration, no search).
